query: Which provably valid user‑cuts (flow‑cover, capacity‑cover, knapsack) are most relevant, what are their canonical constraint templates and lifting rules, and what impact should we expect on convergence?

response.query: Which provably valid user‑cuts (flow‑cover, capacity‑cover, knapsack) are most relevant, what are their canonical constraint templates and lifting rules, and what impact should we expect on convergence?
response.answer: Flow-cover, capacity-cover, and knapsack cuts are relevant; their canonical templates and lifting rules improve convergence by tightening feasible regions. Flow-cover cuts use node-arc incidence constraints; capacity-cover cuts enforce flow limits; knapsack cuts apply to integer programming. These cuts enhance solver efficiency.

results.content: ## Utilities - [ ] If an `AbstractVectorSet`, implement `Utilities.set_dot`, unless the dot product between two vectors in the set is equivalent to `LinearAlgebra.dot` - [ ] If an `AbstractVectorSet`, implement `Utilities.set_with_dimension` in `src/Utilities/matrix_of_constraints.jl` - [ ] Add the set to the `@model` macro at the bottom of `src/Utilities.model.jl` ## Documentation - [ ] Add a docstring, which gives the mathematical definition of the set, along with an `## Example` block containing a `jldoctest` - [ ] Add the docstring to `docs/src/reference/standard_form.md` - [ ] Add the set to the relevant table in `docs/src/manual/standard_form.md` ## Tests - [ ] Define a new `_set(::Type{S})` method in `src/Test/test_basic_constraint.jl` and add the name of the set to the list at the bottom of that files - [ ] If the set has any checks in its constructor, add tests to `test/sets.jl` ## MathOptFormat - [ ] Open an issue at `https://github.com/jump-dev/MathOptFormat` to add support for the new set {{ replace with link to the issue }} ## Optional - [ ] Implement `dual_set(::S)` and `dual_set_type(::Type{S})` - [ ] Add new tests to the `Test` submodule exercising your new set - [ ] Add new bridges to convert your set into more commonly used sets 32.3 Adding a new bridge Use this checklist when adding a new bridge to the MathOptInterface repository.

results.title: Activities - DATA Lab @ Northeastern
results.content: # DATA Lab @ Northeastern Scalable Management and Analysis of Big Data. For fall 2025 we continue our seminars in person in **WVH 462 (map)** with brown bag lunch. We **never record our seminars**, and if we have in-person speakers, we will not use Zoom. We strive our seminars to be an encouraging space for people to explore and share and understand and not worry about how questions may be perceived and later recorded on the Web. If you believe data is the future and are interested to join the seminars, please subscribe to our DATA Lab talks email list. In this talk, I will present two systems that apply this workload-aware approach at different stages of the RAG pipeline. She received a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Stanford University in 2021 and a B.S. in Computer Science from Caltech. Manos Athanassoulis is an Associate Professor of Computer Science at Boston University, Director and Founder of the BU Data-intensive Systems and Computing Laboratory, and co-director of the BU Massive Data Algorithms and Systems Group.
